paths.description: Localized storefront homepage, representing global navigation, merchandising, consent, preferences and initial load.
New products listing, representing catalogue discovery, filters and responsive product grids.
KD19 product detail and add-to-bag attempt, representing product metadata, size selection and the primary commerce journey.
Returns-policy help article, representing long-form support content, search and contact inputs.
Sign-in/join redirect, representing account access and authentication entry.

findings.summary: The storefront is light-only even when the user requests dark mode.
findings.evidence: The dark-mode screenshot remains white and the dark probe reports html color-scheme "normal", body background rgb(255,255,255), and no prefers-color-scheme rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven surface, text and control colors using prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Route and state changes do not use View Transitions.
findings.evidence: Rendered CSS inspection across homepage, listing and product found zero view-transition rules; navigation is an abrupt document/state swap.
findings.suggestedFix: Add same-document or cross-document View Transitions for catalogue-to-product and disclosure state changes, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: The fixed global header does not expose scroll-state-aware feedback.
findings.evidence: The underlying homepage video shows static header chrome, while CSS inspection found no scroll-state query or scroll timeline support.
findings.suggestedFix: Use scroll-state container queries or a declarative progress/shrinking treatment where it improves orientation.

findings.summary: Filter/menu overlays do not use CSS anchor positioning.
findings.evidence: The listing exposes several anchored filter controls, but CSS inspection found zero anchor-name, position-anchor or position-try rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Use CSS anchor positioning with position-try fallbacks for filter menus and tooltips near viewport edges.

findings.summary: A full-screen consent interstitial hides the entire storefront on every fresh visit.
findings.evidence: Desktop and mobile screenshots show the cookie experience covering the content and requiring a choice before any product content can be seen.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce the consent UI to the minimum legally required interruption, preserve equal Accept/Decline prominence, and keep meaningful content visible where policy permits.

findings.summary: The consent modal uses an invalid ARIA role instead of the platform dialog primitive.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports role="modal" as invalid; the DOM has zero dialog elements and the cookie root uses a custom div role.
findings.suggestedFix: Use <dialog> with aria-modal and a valid accessible name, or a valid role="dialog" implementation if native dialog cannot be adopted.

findings.summary: Responsive behavior is viewport-only rather than component-aware.
findings.evidence: The sampled CSS contains zero @container rules across homepage, listing and product despite reusable cards, filters and global shell components.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce containment and size container queries for cards, menus and product panels that appear at multiple widths.

findings.summary: The guest add-to-bag flow did not complete.
findings.evidence: After selecting visible size UK 3 and activating the visible enabled Add to Bag button, the bag accessible label stayed "Bag Items: 0" after seven seconds; HAR/Lighthouse also recorded cart API 403 and 404 responses.
findings.suggestedFix: Make guest cart initialization reliable, show a clear actionable failure state, and add end-to-end monitoring for select-size to cart confirmation.

findings.summary: The account entry point ends at an unstyled Access Denied page.
findings.evidence: Navigating the public Join/Sign In route redirected to accounts.nike.com and returned Access Denied with no recovery link or retry action.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix edge/bot policy false positives for legitimate browsers and return a branded, actionable recovery page when authentication cannot start.

findings.summary: Cold-load performance is far outside the good Core Web Vitals range.
findings.evidence: Mobile Lighthouse measured homepage LCP 13.9s, FCP 7.1s and TBT 830ms (performance 0.36); the product page measured LCP 20.7s and TBT 920ms (performance 0.35). The independent trace measured LCP 7.34s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP resource, reduce startup JavaScript, defer non-critical media and third parties, and verify on representative mobile hardware.

findings.summary: Startup scripting blocks the main thread.
findings.evidence: The trace found three long tasks, a 220.82ms longest task and 226.4ms TBT; Lighthouse measured 830-920ms TBT.
findings.suggestedFix: Break long tasks into yielding chunks, delay non-essential modules, and schedule background work by priority.

findings.summary: The critical network path is large and crowded by parser-inserted resources.
findings.evidence: The homepage HAR recorded 168 requests and 6,268,243 transferred bytes, including multiple VeryHigh parser-inserted stylesheets and High-priority scripts; the largest media segment was 2,032,200 bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce critical CSS, defer or async non-critical scripts after confirming dependencies, and prioritize only the actual LCP asset.

findings.summary: Large amounts of shipped JavaScript and CSS are unused on the initial route.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 86KB unused in the video player, 77KB in recommendation code, 56KB in chat, and 96.8% waste in one 62KB inline stylesheet.
findings.suggestedFix: Route-split optional video, chat and recommendation code; remove duplicate/global CSS and load features only when used.

findings.summary: The accessibility tree contains invalid roles and unnamed controls.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports invalid role="modal" and a menuitem without a required menu/menubar parent; probes found 2-5 unnamed buttons on sampled pages and dozens of empty-text links.
findings.suggestedFix: Correct role ownership, replace the invalid modal role, and give every icon-only button/link a stable accessible name.

findings.summary: Heading structure skips levels and does not consistently reflect page hierarchy.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse flags heading-order failures; the homepage probe shows an empty H1 followed by H3s, later another H1, and H4 groups without a consistent hierarchy.
findings.suggestedFix: Use one descriptive page H1 and a sequential section hierarchy; keep visual typography independent of heading rank.

findings.summary: The page logs network and runtime errors on load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured cart API 403/404, a fingerprint endpoint 429, and an aborted unsupported Summarizer-language request.
findings.suggestedFix: Handle expected network responses without console noise, correct the Summarizer language list, and add monitoring for cart and anti-bot failures.

findings.summary: Images are delivered without intrinsic dimensions.
findings.evidence: The image primitive found all 19 homepage images and all 10 product images missing width/height attributes; the PDP hero was also oversized at 1872 natural pixels for a 780px display.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width and height or aspect-ratio for every image and select right-sized CDN variants.

findings.summary: Deprecated browser APIs and missing source maps reduce platform hygiene.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports three deprecations (Shared Storage, persistent StorageType and Protected Audience) and missing source maps for large first-party JavaScript.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove deprecated API usage and publish production source maps to an access-controlled error-monitoring endpoint.

findings.summary: Transport is HTTPS, but browser defenses and cookie attributes are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers show a CSP limited to frame-ancestors, no X-Content-Type-Options and no Referrer-Policy. Cookie audit found four cookies without Secure, all eight with SameSite=None, and two 395-day identifiers.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP beyond frame-ancestors, add nosniff and a strict referrer policy, and use Secure plus the narrowest SameSite and lifetime each cookie needs.

findings.summary: The pre-consent third-party and telemetry footprint is broad.
findings.evidence: Tracker capture found 12 non-www origins and New Relic; the HAR attributes 58 requests and 3,970,035 bytes to third-party origins on the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit every pre-consent integration, gate non-essential telemetry, batch analytics, and remove vendors whose user value does not justify their data and byte cost.

findings.summary: Core content is server-rendered, but the primary transaction is not resilient.
findings.evidence: Discoverability found 54-61% raw-HTML content coverage and no JS shell, but the exercised add-to-bag operation silently failed when cart APIs returned errors.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep product content server-rendered and progressively enhance cart submission with a recoverable form/server path or an explicit retry state.

findings.summary: Network failures produce dead ends or silent failure instead of recovery.
findings.evidence: The account route displayed a plain Access Denied response, while Add to Bag left the count unchanged and cart requests returned 403/404 without an actionable message.
findings.suggestedFix: Handle auth/cart failure with branded error states, retry/back controls, preserved selection and telemetry that distinguishes policy blocks from service errors.

findings.summary: The localized shell still relies heavily on physical CSS properties.
findings.evidence: Pages correctly declare lang="en-GB", but sampled CSS contained 727-873 physical left/right declarations versus 75-112 logical-property uses and no dir attribute.
findings.suggestedFix: Set direction explicitly where appropriate and migrate reusable layout styles to inline/block logical properties, testing RTL locales.

findings.summary: The failed add-to-bag action gives no clear, actionable error.
findings.evidence: After activation the only populated live-region text observed was the price, while the bag count remained zero; no error dialog or retry message appeared.
findings.suggestedFix: Announce failure in an aria-live region next to the action, preserve the chosen size, and provide Retry or another recovery path.

findings.summary: Support contact inputs lack labels and autocomplete metadata.
findings.evidence: The help probe found consumerName and consumerEmail text inputs with no accessible label and empty autocomplete values.
findings.suggestedFix: Add visible labels and correct autocomplete=name/email tokens; retain programmatic association and clear validation messages.

findings.summary: Image delivery misses intrinsic sizing and responsive-source opportunities.
findings.evidence: Homepage image audit found 19/19 missing dimensions, 14 missing srcset and 14 reported as legacy formats; the PDP hero was more than twice its rendered width.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve responsive modern-format variants from the image CDN with srcset/sizes, intrinsic dimensions and quality appropriate to each placement.

findings.summary: The initial page performs substantial work unrelated to the first task.
findings.evidence: The homepage loaded 81 scripts and 53 fetch/XHR requests; Lighthouse found large unused video, recommendation and chat modules and the trace recorded long startup tasks.
findings.suggestedFix: Conditionally load video, chat and recommendations, deprioritize background fetches, and stop work when content is offscreen or the page is hidden.

findings.summary: Autoplay media and third-party bytes dominate the homepage budget.
findings.evidence: The first viewport autoplays a background hero video; homepage transfer was 6.27MB, including 3.97MB third-party and multiple video/audio segments, before the user could reach content through consent.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a poster by default, honor reduced-data/autoplay preferences, defer media until visible or requested, and set route-specific third-party/media budgets.

taskList.title: Restore reliable guest cart and account entry with actionable failure recovery
Cut LCP, startup JavaScript, critical requests and autoplay media
Harden CSP, response headers and cookie attributes; reduce pre-consent third parties
Repair modal, menu, button and heading accessibility semantics
Optimize and intrinsically size responsive imagery
Add preference-driven dark mode and preserve existing reduced-motion/contrast behavior
Reduce the consent interruption while preserving symmetric choices
Adopt container queries and logical properties in reusable shell/components
Add labels and autocomplete metadata to support/contact inputs
Clean console errors, deprecations and source-map diagnostics
Progressively enhance transactional operations and modernize navigation motion
